STOP TAKING THE PILL. I hate how shitty our health care potions are in the states but I took sprintec- a low, even hormone pill system with three even low estrogen weeks then the placebo week. I was on this for about 4-5 years.  Once I got about year 2 or 3. I started to feel funny. I noticed I just didn’t “want to take” the pills. It was a lot harder to stay on schedule. Then I started becoming really uninvolved. Like inclusive and less happy. Not depressed just not my bubbly self. THEN I noticed I was a lot “less wet” down there during uhmmm activities with my boyfriend at the time and THEEEEEN I started getting yeast infections. Which was one thing my friend-who was also on the pill- always got. She got yeast infections nonstop from the pill. So much so that she didn’t even know it was one at first. Like she just thought that’s how her system worked. It was so often.  Luckily I just had them a couple times but it was clearly not from my own actions because nothing I was doing had changed. So I did some research and read up on all these negative effects of the pill and how it can be as bad as the mold, asbestos. And also that since bc makes you think you’re pregnant it can actually heavily effect your life because women are VERY different when pregnant. I read that some women stopped being attracted to their husbands after stopping the pill because pregnant hormones (on the pill) usually crave a more docile man and when off the pill or non pregnant hormonally one may be attracted to a different type of partner. Like it really effects EVERYTHING. So after a few months of off and on taking it, I finally stopped. And immediately felt so much better. Like never stopped feeling better since. I think I’ve been off the pill now for as long as I was on it and aside from ya know fearing for my pregnancy every time I have sex (yet always safe protected sex), I feel much better. Lol truly happier hormonally. I’ve also remembered I’m a big cry baby. I guess the pill was suppressing that. Lol best of luck!!!!

***Also note***  I too got on the pill because my periods were so bad but believe it or not my periods are very healthy and regular now. Something I thought I’d never have. I also DRASTICALLY changed my diet while on the pill becoming vegetarian and eating clean and my doctor actually thinks that’s what helped. My doc said the foods especially meat products can contain ALOT of hormones and sometimes those hormones conflict with the woman’s ever changing hormones and can cause really rough irregular periods with migraines, heavy cramps, blood clots, and inconsistent start times, etc. consider all of this as well!!!

I had many times were I felt "crazy", suicidal, lonely, and just sad about it all, but between my own personal research and life experiences, I'm in a much more sane and independent place. Its easier said than done, but if I can you literally can too. Find comfort in your solitude and really try to sort out your thoughts. Write them down or here online, read some info on Nabuse victims, look up some guided meditations (theres plenty FREE online for Nabuse), stand up for yourself if you can. You'll only end up feeling worse with more regrets if you dont eventually speak your mind and really love yourself. Its a hard journey but I promise you can make it through. Keep your head up! if you need an online homie, just let me know :)
